method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text and its formulas sidecar with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the employee, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in one module, the rules in another, the employee's questions in a seat module importing them; two regulative rules (s 9(2) and s 26(4), (5)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Long Service Leave Act 2018 (Vic), Act No. 12/2018, Version No. 006 (incorporating amendments as at 12 December 2025), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/long-service-leave-act-2018.txt (committed text sha256 b322f19a05b01034b8926398570a51a40ee0f014c31bcedfdd46e30fb0b92349), converted from the Word file saved by hand by the owner on 2026-11-06; s 16 formulas from long-service-leave-act-2018.formulas.md (18-12a006-F1 to F3)

seat: the employee or former employee to whom the Act gives long service leave (lsl-seat.l4); the s 10 question is asked from the seat of the personal representative of an employee who died

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lsl-dates.l4 ; l4 run lsl-rules.l4 ; l4 run lsl-seat.l4 ; l4 run lsl-cases.l4
checks.result: 195 assertions written, 195 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text and the formulas sidecar.

scope: Long service leave entitlement, continuous employment, ordinary pay and normal weekly hours, taking leave, payment on termination and death, contracting out, recovery and adverse action. In: s 3(1) (employee and reasonable business grounds as facts), ss 5, 6, 7, 8(3), 9, 10(1), (3), 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 (formulas F1-F3), 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24(1)(g), (2) (noted), 26(2)-(7), 27(2), 34(2), 35(1), 36, 37(2), (3), (6), 46-50. Out: ss 1, 2, 4, 8(1), 10(2), 24 (other subsections), 25, 28-33, 34(1), 35(2), 37(4), (5), (7), 38-45, 52, 53, Part 8 (including the s 57 transitional rule for absences that started before commencement). Reasons in NOTES.md.
